inputs.measurement_results: data/results/ - JSON files with bitstring counts per circuit instance
inputs.ideal_amplitudes: data/amplitudes/ - JSON files with ideal complex amplitudes per circuit instance

outputs_required.fidelity_estimates: Per-instance F_XEB with bootstrap uncertainty for each (N, d, r)
outputs_required.comparative_curves: Fidelity vs depth (fixed N) and fidelity vs N (fixed d)
outputs_required.aggregated_statistics: Mean and std across instances for each (N, d) configuration

validation_criteria: Non-zero fidelity at classically challenging scales (N>=40, d>=12)
Exponential decay of fidelity with increasing depth
Systematic reduction in fidelity with increasing qubit count
core_conclusion_to_validate: Gap between experimental fidelity and classical approximability under arbitrary-geometry/high-connectivity random circuits
